name: Todd Snyder
why: American casual clothing and tailoring with the Italian mills named on each product, plus an own-label shoe range and a wall of other makers' shoes.
origin: Founded in New York in 2011 by Todd Snyder, formerly head of menswear at J.Crew.

onething.n: Works, but why is this THE ITEM

notes.ital: All the fabrics are Italian and the tailoring is made in Italy and Portugal — Tollegno cloth named on the product pages, a Pitti Uomo runway show, and Armani cited as the formative influence. Snyder learned to tailor in Des Moines and went to Italy for the cloth. Raised from 3 on 2026-08-09: the rubric says passport is not required, and this is an American brand with Italian mills, Italian make and Italian design language.
notes.golf: TS x FootJoy Premiere Series — a real golf-shoe line with the game's premier maker
notes.cotton: 54% of the clothing range, and 227 of those styles are 100% cotton — oxfords, selvedge denim, chinos, tees. Read across all 1,296 clothing products
notes.tech: almost none: 3% of the range is synthetic, spandex appears in 12% of styles at 1–3% for comfort rather than performance, and there is no house-named or licensed technology anywhere. Water resistance is claimed on eight styles
notes.craft: Todd Snyder product pages name the cloth mill on much of the tailoring and shirting (Thomas Mason, Vitale Barberis Canonico, Baird McNutt, Dondi) and state 'Made in Italy' on the Italian pieces, but name the garment maker only rarely (Dondi on the knit sport coat). Non-Italian shirts and jeans say only 'Imported'. Named mills, nothing owned: a 3. [ruled by Sebastian 4 Oct 2026]
notes.whitet: the Champion collaboration tee is a signature and the brand’s most-bought item — seeded 27 Sep 2026, provisional

craft_evidence.owned_d: No owned facility found on toddsnyder.com; 'Our Mills' content presents partner mills (Albini, Dondi, Pellemoda) as third parties. Brand is owned by American Eagle Outfitters (not checked for facilities; AEO is not a maker of this tailoring).
craft_evidence.countries: Garment country stated 5/9 (sample skewed to Italian lines, so not called most): Italy 5 (knit sport coat, flannel sport coat, trench, knit military shirt, cashmere crew; Wythe trouser fabric Italy, garment per fetch Italy — treat as uncertain); 'Imported' 4/9 (Thomas Mason dress shirt, Irish linen shirt, selvedge oxford, barrel jean) with fabric origin given (Italy, Ireland, Japan, India). Sample of 9-10 PDPs: sport coats, outerwear, shirts, trousers, jeans, knitwear; sample skewed toward Italian lines found by search.
